name: Version 1.0.9
body:
### What's New in Version 1.0.9
- **1-Tap Hadith & Nasihah Status Cards with QR:** Instantly transform Today's Authentic Hadith and Believer's Nasihah into high-resolution, ready-to-post Islamic image cards in both **9:16 Story / WhatsApp Status** and **1:1 Feed Post** formats across 3 curated Islamic themes, complete with a scannable QR code and offline gallery save.
- **Mosque Mode Auto-SMS Signature:** Automatic missed-call replies during prayer now include an optional, user-toggleable Noor-e-Hidayah Mosque Mode signature so friends and family can discover the free, ad-free app naturally.
- **Upgraded 7-Model Tasbih QR Share Cards:** Enhanced completion reward cards across all 7 interactive Tasbih models (Classic, Soften Your Heart, Three-Jar Fatimah, Garden of Jannah, Scales of Mizan, Lantern of Noor & Ripples of Sakina) with crisp branded footers and scannable QR codes.
- **Sadaqah Jariyah — Invite a Friend:** Share Noor-e-Hidayah with loved ones in one tap from Settings using a dedicated branded Islamic invitation card and direct download link.
- **Cleaner Islamic Toolbox & Notification Settings:** Reminders are now organized directly inside Settings → Notification Settings for a cleaner Toolbox layout, alongside smarter in-app update reliability.
